name: TassHunting
description: Hunting overhaul: sticky arrows and spears ride the animal they hit (grab a stuck spear back at melee range), true-aim spawn, 100 percent bow accuracy, unbreakable arrows, animals flee AWAY from the hunter, predator overhaul (apex terror bears, tactical wolf packs), predator footsteps audible at realistic ranges, extended projectile pickup, harvest overhaul (faster knife work, loot drops on the ground instead of a window, empty corpses self-remove). Everything config-gated.
